description: Seed questions for the landing-page AI eval harness. Derived from real inquiries in the support mailbox, paraphrased and stripped of PII. Each category should be expanded to 50-100 variants by the generator.

quoting: Can you quote a shipment with a lot of items — would this be FTL or LTL?
I need a quote for white glove delivery of outdoor furniture from a manufacturer to a residence
Can you quote threshold delivery for a furniture order?
The pickup location requires a call 15 minutes before pickup — can you handle special instructions?
Can this shipment be palletized, and does that change the price?
How fast can you turn around a quote?
Do you quote shipments originating in Canada?
white_glove: The item is flat-pack and needs assembly — can you still do white glove?
What exactly is included in white glove delivery?
What's the difference between curbside, threshold, and white glove?
Do you deliver to room of choice and remove the packaging?
equipment_limits: My item weighs over 2000 lbs — can it still go on a liftgate?
The pallet is 10 feet long — will it fit on a liftgate?
The receiver doesn't have a dock or forklift — what are my options?
booking_process: I approved the quote — what happens next?
How do I get the BOL and shipping labels?
Can you schedule the pickup for tomorrow?
Can I book everything myself online or do I have to email you?
tracking_exceptions: The carrier attempted delivery but couldn't complete it — what now?
The consignee's phone number doesn't work and the carrier can't schedule the appointment — can you help?
My pickup was missed — what do you do about it?
Can you tell me the exact timestamp of the attempted pickup?
The shipment shifted in transit and went back to the dock — when will it deliver?
billing_disputes: I got hit with a reweigh fee but my item weighs less than they billed — can you fix it?
The invoice is higher than the quote — why, and what can I do?
Does an attempted pickup cost me anything?
How do I avoid reclass and reweigh charges?
claims_insurance: My freight arrived damaged — what do I do?
How long do I have to file a damage claim?
Can I add cargo insurance to my shipment?
Who pays when the carrier damages my freight — you or the carrier?
payments_invoicing: Can I pay by ACH or card?
I got a payment reminder but I already paid — who do I contact?
trust_competitive: Are you a carrier or a broker?
Why should I use you instead of going direct to the carrier?
How are you different from other freight brokers or load boards?
Am I talking to a bot or real people?
sales_conversion: I have a shipment from Richardson TX going residential, 40x49x86 at 220 lbs — can you price it?
We already have a broker we're happy with — why would we switch?
Can I just test you with one or two lanes before committing?
How fast can you turn a quote around if I send dims right now?
We don't ship much LTL yet — is it worth setting up an account?
Who else do you ship for in outdoor furniture?
Can I book a call with a real person instead of chatting?
Stop emailing me / take me off your list
I sent you dims an hour ago, where's my quote?
existing_customer_flow: New shipment, dock pickup in City of Industry to a residence, add $1728 insurance — please quote
Quote approved, schedule pickup for tomorrow and send the BOL
The pickup location closes at 2:30pm — can you note the hours on the BOL?
price_negotiation: Was there anything cheaper with TForce?
Your quote is higher than last time — have a better rate next time
Would it be cheaper to package it all on one pallet?
Can you give me two options — cheapest and fastest?
Why is the residential delivery so much more than dock-to-dock?
special_capabilities: Can Estes deliver to an Amazon fulfillment center?
I need 8 pallets on a 26' box truck with liftgate — do you do FTL?
The pallet can't have anything stacked on top — can you guarantee that?
The portal isn't showing Metro for my delivery zip — did you stop using them?
This is an exchange — deliver the new table and take the old one back
fba_tradeshow: I have an FBA shipment ID FBA19XXXXXXX, 1 pallet 48x40x20 at 203 lbs — can you quote LTL to the Amazon FC?
Which carriers can actually deliver to an Amazon fulfillment center?
Can you pick up from my 3PL warehouse and deliver to Amazon same week?
Do you ship FBA inbound to Amazon Canada fulfillment centers?
Amazon rejected the delivery appointment — what happens now?
I need a booth shipped to a convention center with an advance warehouse deadline — can you handle trade show freight?
byo_carrier: We already have a direct contract with Estes — why would we book through you?
Can I connect my own carrier account to your system?
If I book on my own carrier account through your platform, what do you charge?
Who invoices me when I use my own carrier rates — you or the carrier?
Will your system show me my direct rates and your rates side by side?
delivery_exceptions: The sofa didn't fit through my customer's front door and the driver took it away — what happens now?
My customer refused the shipment because it arrived damaged — what's the process?
XPO added a $209 storage fee to my invoice and I was never told about any delivery problem
My shipment hasn't moved in a week and I think it's lost
If a lost shipment is found, does it come back to me or go to my customer?
Can the consignee just pick up the freight at the carrier terminal?
The carrier put my delivery on hold — how do I get it released?
